title: Brotli decoder flaw (CVE-2026-111497), in Node.js, Bun, Python packages and Brotli libraries
summary: A buffer overflow in Google's Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497), in Brotli 1.0.3 to 1.2.0 apart from 1.0.10 and 1.1.1, fixed in 1.0.10, 1.1.1 and 1.2.1 on 21 October 2026. Node.js fixed it in 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1 by cherry-picking the fix, so those still report Brotli 1.2.0; Bun fixed it in 1.4.4; the Brotli and brotlicffi packages in 1.2.1 and 1.2.1.0; Pillow and opencv-python carry their own copies. Version strings can't tell fixed from unfixed here, so Wardlatch reads the decoder itself: the fix added an error code, and its name (_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH) is in every fixed decoder's error table. Others used the error name as the sign of the fix before this check: OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator pull request #7107 looked for the string in a library file, and baealex/BLEX pull request #580 asked the decoder for it at run time. Wardlatch's is the same idea, built into the check (exact NUL-delimited match plus a control string, reading bytes only). Trail of Bits' brotli-checker (github.com/trailofbits/brotli-checker) is another tool that finds bundled copies, and checks source trees and ELF builds.

brotli.fix: Update it with the Python of the environment it is in: '/path/to/env/bin/python3' -m pip install --upgrade 'Brotli>=1.2.1' (uv: uv pip install --python '/path/to/env/bin/python3' --upgrade 'brotli>=1.2.1'; conda: conda install -n ENV 'brotli-python>=1.2.1').

brotlicffi.fix: Update it with the Python of the environment it is in: '/path/to/env/bin/python3' -m pip install --upgrade 'brotlicffi>=1.2.1.0' (uv: uv pip install --python '/path/to/env/bin/python3' --upgrade 'brotlicffi>=1.2.1.0'; conda: conda install -n ENV 'brotlicffi>=1.2.1.0').

pillow.fix: Pillow had no release with a fixed Brotli on 24 October 2026 (12.3.0 and 13.0.0 carry Brotli 1.2.0): update Pillow when one ships. Until then, don't open WOFF2 fonts you didn't make with ImageFont: Pillow's FreeType uses this copy to read them.

opencv-python.fix: opencv-python 5.0.0.93 (the latest 5.x) carries Brotli 1.1.0 through its bundled FFmpeg; we found no way in today; update when a fixed wheel ships.

opencv-contrib-python.fix: opencv-contrib-python 5.0.0.93 (the latest 5.x) carries Brotli 1.1.0 through its bundled FFmpeg; we found no way in today; update when a fixed wheel ships.

fixes.node-line: Install Node.js {fixed} or later, the fixed release for the {major} line, from nodejs.org, your version manager or your package manager; if a version manager installed this copy, remove it once the new one is in place.
fixes.node: Install the fixed release for its line (Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1 or later) from nodejs.org, your version manager or your package manager; if a version manager installed this copy, remove it once the new one is in place.
fixes.node-eol: Node.js {major} is end-of-life and gets no fix from the Node.js project: move to Node.js 22, 24 or 26 (22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1 or later), then remove this copy.
fixes.linked: It uses {lib}, so it is fixed by updating that library, not {what}: {libfix}
fixes.bun: Update Bun to 1.4.4 or later the way you installed it: bun upgrade for Bun's own installer, brew upgrade bun for Homebrew.
fixes.homebrew: brew upgrade brotli (to 1.2.1 or later), then restart the programs that use it.
fixes.macports: sudo port selfupdate && sudo port upgrade brotli (to 1.2.1 or later), then restart the programs that use it.
fixes.conda: conda install -n {env} 'libbrotlidec>=1.2.1' (add -c conda-forge if your channel has no fixed build), then restart the programs that use it.
fixes.library-other: Update whatever installed {lib} to a release with Brotli 1.0.10, 1.1.1, 1.2.1 or later, then restart the programs that use it.
fixes.system-other: Install your distribution's update for its Brotli package when it ships (its security page for CVE-2026-111497 says when), then restart the programs that use it.
fixes.pip-bundled: Update {names} to a release whose own copy of Brotli has the fix (Brotli 1.0.10, 1.1.1, 1.2.1 or later).
fixes.pip-unowned: No package's install record lists this copy: find what put it there, and update or remove it.
fixes.pip-node: This is a Node.js runtime that {names} carries: update {names} when it ships one with the fix (Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, 26.12.1 or later).

hints.node: Check this one by hand, by its version: Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, 26.12.1 and later are fixed, and 20 and older get no fix (https://www.deimoscore.com/wardlatch/brotli/)
hints.bun: Check this one by hand: bun --version must print 1.4.4 or later (Bun's advisory: 1.0.21 to 1.4.3 are affected)
hints.binding: Brotli may be built into it without its error texts: check the version of {names} by hand (Brotli 1.2.1 and brotlicffi 1.2.1.0 and later are fixed)
hints.file: Ask the makers of {names} whether the Brotli it carries is 1.0.10, 1.1.1, 1.2.1 or later

debian:12.name: Debian
debian:12.fix: sudo apt update && sudo apt install --only-upgrade libbrotli1 (Debian 12's fixed package is 1.0.9-2+deb12u1), then restart the programs that use it.

debian:13.name: Debian
debian:13.fix: sudo apt update && sudo apt install --only-upgrade libbrotli1 (Debian 13's fixed package is 1.1.0-2+deb13u1), then restart the programs that use it.

debian:forky.name: Debian
debian:forky.fix: Debian had no fixed package for this release on 24 October 2026: install it when Debian ships one (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-111497), then restart the programs that use it.

safeText: no copy of the Brotli decoder found
notCovered: Electron apps and browsers (they update themselves), programs built with bun build --compile and other single-file programs, Envoy and Istio, container images, re-implementations of Brotli in other languages (such as the Go port, github.com/andybalholm/brotli, fixed in v1.2.7), Python packages that build Brotli into their own files (apart from the Brotli and brotlicffi packages), version managers kept outside their usual folders (NVM_DIR and the like), and Windows. The guide covers more, by hand: https://www.deimoscore.com/wardlatch/brotli/
